remarks: Welcome to 233 Hoyt Street, a spacious, updated 5-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering 2,096 square feet of comfortable living space. This pet-friendly residence features a flexible floor plan with two bedrooms, a full bath, living room, dining room, and eat-in kitchen on the first floor. The second floor boasts three additional bedrooms, a full bath, a kitchenette, and a family room, providing ample space for relaxation and entertainment.   Situated on .15 acres, this property includes a fenced yard, perfect for entertaining. Located within walking distance to the Springdale train station, this home ensures an easy commute. With access two town beaches, and the newly acquired Great Island, this house is not to be missed!
